about: Built by tools/build_mattatuck.py. The Mattatuck publishes no floor plan: this one is approximate, drawn inside the building’s real outline (OpenStreetMap) from the museum’s own descriptions of its rooms (Foyer, café and History Gallery on the main floor, art galleries and Rooftop Terrace upstairs, Performing Arts Center, Community Gallery and buttons on the 3rd floor).
source: Approximate: OpenStreetMap building outline and the Mattatuck Museum’s visit, rental, exhibition and collection pages

floors.label: Main Floor
floors.area: Entrance from the plaza · Foyer · Welcome Desk · Shop · Art of Yum Café · Restrooms · History Gallery

rooms.name: West Main Street, on the north-west corner of the Waterbury Green
Park Place: turn in here for the museum’s free parking lots
Sidewalk along West Main Street (large windows show the shows inside)
Plaza and sculpture garden on the corner of West Main Street and Park Place: the way in
Museum parking on Park Place: free (more in the large lot past the YMCA play area and the Gaffney Place lot; GPS 26 Park Place). Four EV charging spaces, free for members
The Foyer (lobby): Welcome Desk for tickets, maps and the wheelchair, large windows on the Green
Museum Shop (books on the collection, Waterbury gifts)
Coat room: backpacks, large bags and big umbrellas go here (locking cubbies); the wheelchair to borrow
Restrooms (accessible)
Classrooms and studio (programs, workshops, School’s OUT!)
Hall to the elevator and stairs
Art of Yum Café: lunch, coffee and treats. Food and drink only here and on the Rooftop Terrace
History Gallery: Waterbury, a City of Transitions (Orton P. Camp Jr. History Exhibit), Meet Fortune, and history shows
